clips.caption:
If someone can push your buttons, they are in control of you.

Kevin Trudeau describes a spouse or friend saying one thing and you suddenly feel an irrational anger you did not choose.

He says that leaves you like a puppet on a string, with someone else running your reactions.

Kevin calls the cause an energetic imprint: a memory with strong emotion attached to it.

When did you last react in a way you did not choose?
